Assumptions I made (it's a non-interactive run):

- **Voice-over:** Seedance doesn't list Armenian as a supported speech language, so it shouldn't make the voice. It only makes the picture and quiet room sound. You add your recorded voice-over and any music in editing. Nobody speaks on screen, so mouths never have to match the words.
- **Upload:** I did not upload the voice-over to Seedance, because it might copy or remake the voice.
- **Shot length:** each shot gets at least 3 s, the shortest a Seedance time slice should be.
- **Text on screen:** Seedance garbles Armenian letters, so the logo and "0–16" go on in editing, not in the generated video. Page text is shown blurred on purpose.
- **Child:** there's no reference photo, so the girl is described in words only. The description is repeated word for word in every shot so she stays the same.
- **Brand colours:** graphite and black, plus one warm lamp. The red book (#D90429) is the only red thing in the film.
- **Session start:** there was no git repo or NOTES.md here, so I couldn't pull or check open items. Nothing was saved to the repo.

**The idea (film-crew):** a child alone in the dark with a question. A book opens and lights up her face. The film ends on a small pool of light, with the top of the frame left empty for the logo. The cut from darkness to light is the whole message, so there are only 3 shots, one per voice-over line.

| Shot | Time | Voice-over | Picture |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–4.3 s | "Every child has a question nobody answered." | Close-up: the girl at a night window. She turns to the dark, empty room and waits. |
| 2 | 4.3–9.3 s | "We write the books that answer it — in Armenian." | Small hands open a red book from above. The camera tilts up to her face, lit by the pages, and she smiles. |
| 3 | 9.3–15 s | "Maghakian Scripts. Books for ages zero to sixteen." | High wide shot: the camera slowly pulls back from the girl reading in the lamp light. The top third stays black for the logo. |

- **Cut timing:** each cut comes about 0.2 s before the next line starts, so the picture changes on the breath before the words.
- **Last 1.5 s:** the picture holds still so the end card sits on it cleanly.
- **Sound:** night room sound only, about −30 dB under the voice-over, with one page-turn sound at 4.6 s.

## FINAL

**Seedance 2.5 settings (Dreamina)**
- Mode: Omni Reference (text only, no uploads)
- Duration: 15 s
- Aspect ratio: 9:16
- Resolution: 1080p if your plan has it, otherwise 720p
- Make 2–3 versions and pick the one where the girl stays the same and the page text stays blurred.

**Prompt**
```text
A quiet, intimate 15-second vertical film in a child's bedroom at night: a small girl alone with a question in the dark, then a red book opens and warm light from its pages fills her face; it ends on a high wide frame of her reading in a small pool of lamp light, the top of the frame left in black. Three shots, hard cuts, naturalistic cinematic realism, fine 35mm film grain, deep graphite and black shadows, one warm amber practical light, the book's deep crimson-red cloth cover is the only red object in the whole film.

Character (identical in every shot): a 7-year-old Armenian girl, dark brown hair in one loose side braid, large dark eyes, light olive skin, wearing an oversized cream knitted sweater with sleeves covering half her hands. Natural child behaviour, no posing, never looks into the lens.

Room (identical in every shot): small bedroom with dark wooden floorboards, graphite-grey walls, a tall window with thin white curtains on frame-left, a low wooden bed, stacks of closed books along the wall, one brass floor lamp with a warm amber shade. Moonlight is cool and faint from the window; all warmth comes from the lamp and the book.

[0-4.3s] Shot 1, close-up, 50mm, eye level, camera locked off with a slight handheld breath. The girl kneels at the dark window, chin resting on her folded arms on the windowsill, eyes searching the night sky; cool blue moonlight rims her cheek and braid, her breath leaves a small patch of fog on the glass. At 2s she turns her head slowly away from the window toward the dark room behind the camera, and stops: eyebrows lifted, lips slightly parted, waiting; nobody is there. Hold on her still, waiting face until the cut. Sound: quiet night room tone, faint wind against the glass. No speech.

[4.3-9.3s] Shot 2, one continuous move. Starts as a top-down insert at 35mm: the girl's small hands, half-covered by cream sweater sleeves, open a hardback book with a deep crimson-red cloth cover on the wooden floor; as the pages open, warm amber lamp light bounces up off the white paper. The lines of print stay soft and out of focus, not readable. The camera tilts and rises smoothly up to a medium close-up of her face, now lit warmly from below by the pages; her eyes move left to right across the lines, then at 7.5s the corners of her mouth press into a small held smile and stay there. Sound: one crisp paper page turn at 4.6s, then soft cloth rustle, low room tone. No speech.

[9.3-15s] Shot 3, high wide angle from near the ceiling, 24mm. The girl sits cross-legged on the floor reading the open red book, small in the centre of a round pool of warm amber light from the brass floor lamp; the rest of the room, the bed, the window and the book stacks fall off into graphite and black. The camera pulls slowly up and back, keeping her in the lower half of the frame, then from 13.5s holds completely still to the end. The upper third of the frame is near-black, empty negative space. Sound: low night room tone only, fading slightly. No speech.

Global: same girl, same sweater, same braid, same room and the same light direction in all three shots; the red book cover is the only saturated red. No speaking and no lip movement as dialogue, no voices, no narration, no background music, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no letters readable anywhere, no extra people, no adults, no toys with faces, no cartoon style, no slow-motion, no lens flares. Pure video with quiet natural ambience only.
```

**Editing (CapCut / Premiere) after you generate**
1. Put the Armenian voice-over at 0.0 s and line it up with the cuts at 4.3 s and 9.3 s. Lower the Seedance room sound to about −30 dB under the voice.
2. Optional music: one soft instrument (felt piano or a single string), very low.
3. End card from 9.8 s, set over the black top third of shot 3:
   - "MAGHAKIAN SCRIPTS" in white (#FFFFFF), placed in the black top third.
   - Below it, "0–16" in red (#D90429), or the Armenian line «Գրքեր 0-ից 16 տարեկանների համար» in white with "0–16" in red.
   - Fade the text in over 0.4 s and hold it to 15 s.
4. Export 1080×1920, 15 s.

**Risks**
- **Page text:** Seedance may still draw fake letters on the pages. If it does, pick a version where they're blurred, or blur them in editing.
- **Same girl:** if she looks different from shot to shot, make a still of her with banana-pro first and run this again with that image as @Image 1, marked as a strict identity reference.
